<thought>Using the correct functional group names ('aliphatic hydroxyls' and 'alkyl halide'), search the template catalog for a substitution template that breaks a C‑O bond and forms a C‑Cl bond. This template will be applied to the target molecule (the concatenated SMILES from the previous step) to obtain its possible precursors.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COc1cccc(NC=O)c1.FC1CN(Cc2ccc(Cn3nnc(Cl)c3Cl)cc2)C1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkyl halide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C-O"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-Cl"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
